title: system.toml
description: The learner's harness manifest, as the JSON value of the parsed TOML. It tells ol how to build the system, which argv runs each role of spec/cli-roles.md, which local services a milestone starts, and where the deployed system lives. String values may hold runner placeholders such as {port}, {config}, or {engine.port}.

name.description: The system's name. It prefixes Kubernetes objects and charts, so it is a DNS label.

course_version.description: The contracts/VERSION semver the learner built against.

build.description: Run in order before any service starts; a failure aborts the milestone.

services.description: Local processes the milestone runner starts, keyed by instance name. Ports are allocated per run.

api_base.description: The OpenAI base URL clients use, for example http://127.0.0.1:{gateway.port}/v1.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable holding the API key. Default TL_API_KEY.

model.description: The model name conformance requests send. Default tracer.

ci.description: MS-P0 ci-status, used when the repo has no GitHub remote.

deploy.description: The deployed system, for kind milestone steps and drills only.

gateway_health_url.description: Optional: where the gateway's health port is reachable from the host on kind. Without it, conformance on kind reports the healthz case pending.

traces.description: Trace query API: Jaeger (Pass 1, :30686) or Tempo (from Pass 7, :30320).

services.description: Logical name to workload, as kubectl names it: deploy/<name> or statefulset/<name>.

argv.description: A command as an argv list: the program, then its arguments. Never a shell string.

entry.description: The [entry] role to run. Default: the service's own name.

section.description: The runtime.toml section whose listen keys get this instance's ports. Default: the service's own name.

config.description: A runtime.toml template, relative to the repo root; the runner writes a filled copy per instance as {config}.

health.description: URL polled until it answers 200. Default http://127.0.0.1:{health_port}/healthz.

after.description: Services that must be healthy first.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the entry argv for this instance.

env.description: Extra environment variables for this instance, typically TL_<SECTION>__<KEY> overrides of runtime.toml (for example TL_ENGINE__ROLE = "decode" for a decode engine sharing the engine template). Values may hold placeholders.
